task_identity_policy: Every task has exactly one stable task_id. The task_id is the only canonical identity used across Master Brain, runtime, execution, evidence, verification, dashboards and chats.
task_record_policy: Each task is one canonical record containing its operational details. Runtime ledgers, evidence, verification and dashboards may attach records to the same task_id but may not create a competing task record or task identity.
task_count_policy: Task count is derived only from the tasks array in this registry at read time. Never pad, infer, backfill, merge, or source extra tasks from chat, dashboards, runtime ledgers, execution registries or model memory to reach a requested count.
current_work_policy: Exactly one current_work record may be active. It must reference an existing task_id in this registry. current_work is a pointer, not a second task record.

reporting_rule: AX must read this registry first for every task count and task status report. The number reported must equal the current length of tasks exactly. Every reported task must include its task_id, name, approval_status, execution_status, timestamp, and linked canonical details. AX must never add an external task to make the count match a prior report. If the registry changes from 8 tasks to 7, report 7; if it changes to 9, report 9. Any task not present in this registry is not a master task and must not be reported as one.
